saw_lines: Language learners buy a course when they feel stuck, then judge it by whether the first lesson feels doable.
So the sale is won or lost on the free trial, which must be visible before any price appears.
Your homepage puts Try Core Grammar 1 for free up front, so put that free lesson in the first line of your next text ads.
